programme.title: Dhamaal
programme.desc: Dhamaal is a madcap comedy about four lazy and broke friends who accidentally learn about a hidden treasure buried in Goa. What follows is a hilarious adventure filled with unexpected twists, car chases, and laugh-out-loud moments as they race against others to find the fortune. Directed by Indra Kumar, this film is known for its clean humor and slapstick fun, making it a cult classic in Indian comedy.

programme.title: Kissa Ka Bhai Kissi Ki Jaan
programme.desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest brother of three siblings, refuses to get married to maintain harmony in his family. However, complications arise after his brothers conspire for him to fall in love.

programme.title: Iqbal
programme.desc: Iqbal is an inspiring sports drama about a young boy (played by Shreyas Talpade) who is deaf and mute but dreams of playing cricket for the Indian national team. With the help of a reclusive former cricketer (Naseeruddin Shah), he trains rigorously, battling societal prejudices, family pressure, and systemic challenges. Directed by Nagesh Kukunoor, the film is a heartfelt celebration of determination, dreams, and triumph against adversity. It’s widely appreciated for its emotional depth and uplifting narrative.
